decisions.decision: Separate local product repository; immutable hashed research inputs; no upstream source or asset reuse.
Use Node 22 standard-library foundation tooling, built-in tests and JSON tracking without selecting a product execution engine.
Apache-2.0 is proposed; no product license grant or public naming clearance is approved.
Preserve modular governance and restricted worker boundary. Parser, driver, locks, ledger and recovery require actual WP0 acceptance.

Pin Node22.23.3/npm10.9.9, TypeScript6.0.2, node-oracledb7.0.1 Thin, Postgres.js3.4.9; evaluate Flyway13.9.0 on Temurin21.0.12.1+1/Maven3.9.16. Exact source/artifact/license evidence exists; no proprietary driver requirement or product/distribution approval.

Driver-free Flyway packaging works, but corpus has 11 comment/SQL*Plus compatibility failures. Reject this profile for execution; T03 remains blocked until a licensed mature parser satisfies all required goldens. No custom tokenizer/grammar/splitter fallback.

Select unchanged Apache-2.0 PL/SQL grammars-v4 7df52be9 with ANTLR4.13.2 BSD runtime, reviewed project-authored hook rewrites, lossless parser-context/token byte adapter and complete-release prevalidation. Exact31file corpus and4realhelper regressions pass. External generator/JDK and separate runtime; no headerless upstream bases, custom grammar/splitter, runtime execution or product-distribution approval. This supersedes the rejected Flyway profile for offline T03 only; runtime ADR-I03/G2 requires both Oracle versions.

Development scheduling uses independent PRODUCT and VALIDATION tracks. Oracle runtime and acceptance remain VALIDATION gates; original catalog and imported work acceptance dependencies are immutable and enforced for verification.

Owner selected unmodified PolyForm Shield 1.0.0 for independently authored software/current documentation. Free internal use; competing products/services restricted; noncompeting paid support not categorically prohibited. Third-party grants and immutable research provenance retained; naming and F31 distribution closure remain pending.
